## Blog

- [Blog](https://microlink.io/blog.md): Engineering details through Microlink.
- [Know which antibot system blocked your request](https://microlink.io/blog/antibot-detection-at-scale.md): is-antibot is an open-source, dependency-free library that tells you when a response was blocked by an antibot system and which provider blocked it. Microlink uses it to handle those failures at scale.
- [Audit the Open Graph tags of every page in your sitemap](https://microlink.io/blog/automate-open-graph-audit.md): Build a Node.js script that reads your sitemap, fetches each URL with Microlink, and reports every page with a missing Open Graph image, title, description, author, date, or logo.
- [Isolated worlds cut visible automation by 99%](https://microlink.io/blog/automation-leaks-are-not-just-the-webdriver-flag.md): Before a screenshot, browserless walked the DOM inside the page, where any site could watch. Isolated worlds cut those calls from 1.7M to 14.6K across ten live sites, made captures cheaper, and surfaced three emulation bugs along the way.
- [Microlink now reads brand logos from DNS](https://microlink.io/blog/brand-logos-are-hiding-in-dns.md): BIMI puts brand logos in DNS as square SVGs. How Microlink uses that record for the logo property, what the top 500 sites say about coverage, and how to publish one for your company.
- [Automate a headless browser with +30 query parameters](https://microlink.io/blog/browser-automation.md): Control a headless browser via API. Use 30+ parameters to automate screenshots, PDFs, metadata extraction, and browser actions without managing infrastructure.
- [Call Chrome Built-in AI from Node.js without a GPU](https://microlink.io/blog/chrome-built-in-ai-from-nodejs.md): Chrome Built-in AI only exists inside a page, and Chrome for Testing will not download Gemini Nano. How we pack the model once, unpack it on the server, and call Prompt, Summarizer, and Language Detector from Node.js, on CPU, with no GPU and no extra API key.
- [Compress Microlink functions with brotli, gzip, or lz-string](https://microlink.io/blog/compress.md): Learn how to use the `function` parameter to execute remote JavaScript code. Optimize your API requests by compressing functions using Brotli, Gzip, or lz-string.
- [Every Microlink docs page is now available as Markdown](https://microlink.io/blog/documentation-as-markdown.md): Every docs page at microlink.io can now be consumed as markdown. Learn why this matters and how we implemented it with Microlink API in a few lines.
- [Cached API responses are now free and edge-served](https://microlink.io/blog/edge-cdn.md): Learn how Microlink CDN uses Global Edge Caching to speed up API responses, optimize images with WebP, and save your API quota by serving cached requests for free.
- [How we made WebGL screenshots up to 3× faster](https://microlink.io/blog/faster-webgl-screenshots.md): WebGL-heavy pages (3D maps, charts, and games) used to be slow and timeout-prone to screenshot. By switching our headless browser from SwiftShader to Mesa llvmpipe, they now render up to 3× faster, with no timeouts.
- [How OpenAI agents used Microlink to escape a GET-only sandbox](https://microlink.io/blog/how-microlink-accidentally-became-the-perfect-escape-hatch-for-openai-agents.md): Agents sandboxed to GET-only browsing used Microlink to execute the POST requests they were forbidden from making. The requests they left behind, and why we consider it a valid use case.
- [Our 2019 plan: MQL, a GraphQL endpoint, and hover previews](https://microlink.io/blog/master-plan-for-2019.md): Explore Microlinks 2019 roadmap, featuring the launch of Microlink Query Language (MQL) for advanced scraping, a GraphQL endpoint, and interactive hover previews.
- [Microlink adblock now dismisses cookie banners automatically](https://microlink.io/blog/microlink-adblock-now-handles-cookie-banners.md): Microlink adblock now combines network-level blocking with automatic cookie consent handling, so you get cleaner screenshots and metadata without custom scripts.
- [Extract any field from a website with custom rules](https://microlink.io/blog/microlink-api-introducing-custom-rules.md): Learn how to use Microlink Custom Rules to extract specific data from any website by defining jQuery-like selectors, attributes, and data types via API parameters.
- [Microlink PDF: turn any URL into a PDF](https://microlink.io/blog/microlink-api-introducing-microlink-pdf.md): Turn any URL into a high-quality PDF using the Microlink API. Learn how to customize margins, scale, and media types, and serve PDFs directly via our global CDN.
- [How Microlink Cards stores every design in a URL](https://microlink.io/blog/microlink-cards.md): Learn how Microlink Cards uses Monaco Editor, URL-based state management with lz-string compression, and the Microlink API to generate dynamic social images at scale.
- [Microlink MCP gives AI agents screenshots, PDFs, and clean Markdown](https://microlink.io/blog/microlink-mcp-the-web-llm-ready.md): Microlink is now available as an MCP server. Screenshots, PDFs, markdown conversion, and web scraping through natural language. The web, LLM-ready.
- [Microlink Proxy resolves blocked URLs on every Pro plan](https://microlink.io/blog/microlink-proxy-how-it-works.md): Bypass geographic restrictions and IP blacklists with Microlink Proxy. Learn how our automatic rotation layer ensures successful data extraction.
- [Microlink SDK v4.5 embeds native iframes from oEmbed providers](https://microlink.io/blog/microlink-sdk-v45-introducing-iframe-support.md): Enhance your link previews with native iframe support in Microlink SDK v4.5. Learn how to embed rich content from Spotify, YouTube, and Instagram using oEmbed.
- [Optimizing Microlink Functions](https://microlink.io/blog/optimizing-microlink-functions.md): Microlink Functions now fetch the page only when your code reads it, through an IPC channel into the isolate, and find their own page without touching other requests. How each speedup was built, and the three wrong guesses before the second one.
- [Product brief #1: default prerendering, new plans, and metascraper v3](https://microlink.io/blog/product-brief-1.md): Learn about Microlink first product brief: enabling browser prerendering by default, the launch of adaptive pricing plans, and the release of metascraper v3.
- [Product brief #2: new brand, unified docs, instant API credentials](https://microlink.io/blog/product-brief-2-new-branding-documentation--improvements.md): Discover Microlink second product brief, featuring a fresh brand identity, unified documentation portal, and key improvements to metascraper and the SDK.
- [Product brief #3: video and up to 50% faster prerendering](https://microlink.io/blog/product-brief-3-video-support-better-prerendering--sdk-features.md): Boost your link previews with Microlink video support, auto-prerendering for 50% faster responses, and new SDK features.
- [Product brief #4: CSS styling in SDK 2.0 and more video providers](https://microlink.io/blog/product-brief-4-sdk-v2--more-video-providers.md): Microlink SDK 2.0 removed the round parameter in favor of plain CSS, and the Microlink API extended video detection to Amazon, Facebook, Instagram, Vimeo, X, YouTube, and more.
- [Product brief #5: user agent and video parameters](https://microlink.io/blog/product-brief-5-new-api-parameters--gallery-showcase.md): Discover Microlink Product Brief, featuring custom User Agent support, optimized video detection parameters, and the major metascraper v3.11 update with Custom Rules.
- [Product brief #6: custom rules turn the API into a scraper](https://microlink.io/blog/product-brief-6-custom-rules--metadata-improvements.md): Unlock the power of Microlink Custom Rules to transform our API into a "scraper-as-a-service.".

Plus, explore our new Documentation Portal.
- [unavatar.io is now generally available with a PRO plan](https://microlink.io/blog/unavatario-generally-available-now.md): unavatar.io, the unified API for resolving user avatars from any social network, is generally available. The new PRO plan removes the daily cap and resolves avatars behind bot protection using residential proxies.
- [How one Chrome flag made GPU-less WebGL screenshots 4× faster](https://microlink.io/blog/webgl-without-a-gpu.md): A deep dive into how Microlink renders WebGL screenshots on a GPU-less fleet: the ANGLE delegation chain, why SwiftShader is slow, how Mesa llvmpipe JIT-compiles the pipeline with LLVM, the Xvfb surface requirement, and the silent 2D fallback we guard against in CI.
- [Headless browsers are easy locally and hard in production](https://microlink.io/blog/what-is-a-headless-browser.md): Learn how headless web browser enables scraping SPAs, creating assets and E2E testing, and why self-hosting infrastructure is often a trap.
- [Why we still run Chrome](https://microlink.io/blog/why-we-still-run-chrome.md): Lightpanda, Obscura, and Cloudflare Kitesurf remove parts of the browser that agents do not need. We compare the trade-offs, what Chrome already offers, and why Chrome remains Microlink’s source of truth.
